title: Progress Ring
summary: A value from 0 to 100, or an unknown one, drawn as a ring on the control ladder, with the percentage or a picture in the middle.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

size.description: The avatar's ladder (owner decision C131 (5)): at every step the ring is the box of an sf-avatar of the same size -- 16 / 24 / 32 / 40 / 48 / 56 px at 1/4...3 on a wide screen, 16 / 20 / 28 / 36 / 44 / 52 on a phone, 16 / 20 / 24 / 32 / 40 / 48 in a compact region (1/4 is 16 on every screen, as sf-avatar 1/4, owner decision C132) -- so a ring can stand where an avatar of its step stands and wrap the avatar one step down: from 1/3 up on a wide screen, from 1/2 up on a phone and in a compact region (1/3 is 20 there, its middle 12); 1/4 has no avatar step below it. 3 is also the circle of a page's empty state. The percentage shows from 1 up.

status.description: What the value reports, in the shared status vocabulary (owner decision C131 (1)). Empty, the default, draws the theme's primary; neutral is grey, as in sf-dot and sf-badge; info, success, warning and error their roles. The word this component used before, primary, is still accepted and means the default. With warning-at or error-at the ring takes the more serious of this status and the threshold the value reached.

warning-at.description: A threshold in per cent: from this value on, the component is a warning by itself (a disk 83 % full of a warning-at 80). The page sets the threshold; the component only compares. Unset, no threshold.

error-at.description: A threshold in per cent: from this value on, the component is an error by itself (a disk 83 % full of a warning-at 80). The page sets the threshold; the component only compares. Unset, no threshold. Above warning-at when both are set.

indeterminate.description: The value is unknown: the spinner's arc goes round the ring and no value is said.

meter.description: The ring shows an amount within a known range (a quota used), not a task's progress: role meter instead of progressbar.

show-text.description: Shows the percentage in the middle; the slot content takes its place when given.

label.description: The accessible name; without it the host's aria-label names the ring.

value-text.description: The value as people say it («3 из 5 файлов»), read instead of the percentage.

chunk.summary: Shows a part of a job (vocabulary §5.2 chunk {done, total}): value becomes done of total in per cent; total defaults to 100. Takes chunk({done, total}) or chunk(done, total).

forbidden_client_responsibilities: running, cancelling or retrying the task
inferring success, warning or error from the numeric percentage

accessibility.focus: Progress Ring is not interactive and never enters the focus order.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-progress-ring for a value from 0 to 100 in the room of a control (a toolbar, a rail, around an avatar), or for an unknown one with indeterminate.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not omit a localized accessible label
Do not infer semantic status from the percentage
Do not make the progress indicator focusable
Do not use the ring for a long task in a page's body; use sf-progress-bar
